title: 24/7 Autonomous AI Web Agent
description: An autonomous agent running 24/7 on a VPS that researches, writes, tests, and deploys high-traffic utility websites daily.
description_en: An autonomous agent running 24/7 on a VPS that researches, writes, tests, and deploys high-traffic utility websites daily.
description_id: Agen otonom yang berjalan 24/7 di VPS yang meneliti, menulis, menguji, dan meluncurkan situs web utilitas trafik tinggi setiap hari.
content_en:
Project Overview

This project is an enterprise-grade autonomous web development agent operating continuously (24/7) on an isolated Virtual Private Server (VPS). Designed to build programmatic utility web applications, the agent autonomously executes the end-to-end software development lifecycle: niche keyword research, full-stack application code synthesis, unit testing, continuous integration, and cloud edge deployment.

The Challenge

Building, verifying, and publishing high-performing web tools traditionally requires hours of engineering per project. Maintaining high output across multiple domains demands continuous market monitoring, rapid prototyping, and automated DevOps infrastructure that can run reliably without human intervention or memory leaks.

The Solution

I engineered a robust multi-agent orchestration architecture written in Python and Go, managed via Docker containers and systemd daemons on Linux. The system integrates frontier LLMs (Claude 3.5 Sonnet & GPT-4o) with strict sandboxed runtime execution. It leverages Playwright for automated browser-based end-to-end verification and pushes finalized Next.js/Tailwind builds directly to Vercel Edge and Cloudflare Pages via CLI automation.

Key Features

  • 24/7 Autonomous Loop: Continuous daemon cycle analyzing high-intent search queries and generating targeted web utilities.
  • Automated Code Generation & Linting: Generates clean, accessible, and responsive TypeScript and Tailwind CSS interfaces.
  • Self-Healing & Testing: Sandboxed execution environment that automatically detects build errors, feeds error logs back to the LLM, and self-corrects prior to deployment.
  • CI/CD Edge Pipeline: Automatic domain binding, SSL provisioning, and zero-downtime deployment via cloud API webhooks.
  • Performance Optimization: Pre-renders static assets ensuring 95+ Google Lighthouse scores across all generated applications.

Tech Stack

  • Runtime & Orchestration: Python, Golang, Linux VPS, systemd, Docker
  • AI Core: Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet, OpenAI GPT-4o, LangChain
  • Web Frameworks: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
  • Testing & DevOps: Playwright, ESLint, Git, Vercel CLI, Cloudflare API
content_id:
Ringkasan Proyek

Proyek ini adalah agen pengembangan web otonom kelas enterprise yang beroperasi tanpa henti (24/7) pada Virtual Private Server (VPS) terisolasi. Dirancang untuk membangun aplikasi web utilitas programatis, agen ini secara otonom mengeksekusi siklus hidup pengembangan perangkat lunak secara end-to-end: riset kata kunci niche, sintesis kode aplikasi full-stack, pengujian unit, integrasi berkelanjutan, dan deployment edge cloud.

Tantangan Proyek

Membangun, memverifikasi, dan meluncurkan alat web berperforma tinggi secara tradisional membutuhkan berjam-jam waktu rekayasa per proyek. Mempertahankan output tinggi di berbagai domain menuntut pemantauan pasar tanpa henti, pembuatan prototipe cepat, dan infrastruktur DevOps otomatis yang dapat berjalan andal tanpa intervensi manusia atau kebocoran memori.

Solusi Teknis

Saya merancang arsitektur orkestrasi multi-agen yang tangguh menggunakan Python dan Go, dikelola melalui kontainer Docker dan daemon systemd di Linux. Sistem mengintegrasikan LLM terdepan (Claude 3.5 Sonnet & GPT-4o) dengan eksekusi runtime sandboxed yang ketat. Sistem memanfaatkan Playwright untuk verifikasi end-to-end berbasis browser otomatis dan mengirimkan build Next.js/Tailwind yang telah selesai langsung ke Vercel Edge dan Cloudflare Pages melalui otomatisasi CLI.

Fitur Utama

  • Siklus Otonom 24/7: Siklus daemon berkelanjutan yang menganalisis kueri pencarian bervolume tinggi dan menghasilkan utilitas web terarah.
  • Pembuatan Kode & Linting Otomatis: Menghasilkan antarmuka TypeScript dan Tailwind CSS yang bersih, aksesibel, dan responsif.
  • Perbaikan Mandiri (Self-Healing) & Pengujian: Lingkungan eksekusi sandboxed yang mendeteksi kesalahan build secara otomatis, mengirimkan log error kembali ke LLM, dan memperbaiki diri sendiri sebelum deployment.
  • Pipeline CI/CD Edge: Pengikatan domain otomatis, provisi SSL, dan deployment zero-downtime melalui webhook API cloud.
  • Optimasi Performa: Melakukan pra-render aset statis untuk memastikan skor Google Lighthouse 95+ di semua aplikasi yang dihasilkan.

Teknologi yang Digunakan

  • Runtime & Orkestrasi: Python, Golang, Linux VPS, systemd, Docker
  • Core AI: Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet, OpenAI GPT-4o, LangChain
  • Framework Web: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
  • Pengujian & DevOps: Playwright, ESLint, Git, Vercel CLI, Cloudflare API
